channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Republicans reject complaint about Gabbard as Democrats question time it took to see it
item.description: The top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee said he will keep looking into it.

item.title: A Colorado funeral home stashed 189 decaying bodies and handed out fake ashes. His mother was among them.
item.description: Return to Nature funeral home co-owner Jon Hallford will be sentenced Friday, facing between 30 to 50 years in prison.

item.title: Census Bureau plans to use survey with a citizenship question in its test for 2030, alarming experts
item.description: The ACS includes a citizenship question while the census form does not.

item.title: Louisville City Council votes to acquire $400K railcar property as ‘gateway’ to historic downtown
item.description: Supporters say the railcars offer a visible link to Louisville’s past, while critics question the price tag and preservation value.

item.title: Broncos WR Troy Franklin says he’s ‘going to get a 1,000-yard season’ in 2026
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO --- In their end-of-year meeting a year ago, Sean Payton told Troy Franklin -- in certain terms -- that he wanted him to play more like a Tesla.

item.title: Silver Creek’s Bob Banning to say goodbye to coaching
item.description: When this season is complete, Bob Banning will retire from a coaching career that began in 1978. He is the only boys basketball head coach in Silver Creek’s history

item.title: Protesters demand CU Regents cut ties with Key Lime Air, grant union rights
item.description: More than 100 protesters in two rallies on Thursday called on the University of Colorado to cancel its contract with Key Lime Air and grant university workers collective bargaining rights.

item.title: Lafayette council raises familiar concerns over U.S. 287 development plan
item.description: Council members raised many of the same issues with an early sketch plan that were previously flagged by planning commissioners and city staff, including walkability and comprehensive plan alignment.

item.title: Boulder girls basketball stomps Mountain Range to extend winning streak
item.description: Led by first-year head coach Matt Johnston and a strong junior class, Boulder girls basketball has caught fire amid its push toward the postseason. item.title: Noodles to implement reverse stock split this month
item.description: Noodles & Co.’s (Nasdaq: NDLS) shareholders approved a 1-for-8 reverse stock split Wednesday and the fast-casual chain plans to implement it on Feb. 18.
